description: National Physical Planning Department- The Town and Country Planning Ordinance (Chappter 269) Order Under Section 6(2)(b) and Section 21(2)(b)
reasoning: This gazette primarily deals with land designation and planning matters. It declares a specific land area ("Rambadagalle Monaragala Rajamaha Vihara Area") as an urban development area and directs the preparation of an outline physical plan. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, survey information, and cadastral references, which are characteristic of land-related gazette notifications under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the core land planning function, making it a Land Gazette rather than a government personnel classification.
